neighbours.label: the modifier slot in 'in the ___ direction/dimension' (opposite, other, either, lateral, different): the word that picks a direction
fire: When the alarm sounded, the crowd began running in the opposite direction from the exit.
Cars were backed up for miles in either direction on the highway.
After years of strict rules, the school swung too far in the other direction.
The scanner improves image quality in the lateral dimension of the tissue.
Her family pulled her in several different directions at once.
From the summit, the valley falls away steeply in every direction.
The arrow on the sign pointed in the wrong direction entirely.
Small errors in any direction will push the model to a worse fit.
quiet: When the alarm sounded, the crowd did the opposite of what the guards wanted.
Cars were parked on either side of the narrow highway.
After years of strict rules, the other teachers finally relaxed.
The scanner improves image quality for lateral thinkers in the lab.
Her family gave her several different gifts at once.
From the summit, every hiker could see the valley below.
The sign on the door had the wrong address entirely.
Small errors of any kind will push the model to a worse fit.

predictions: Fires on opposite/other/either/any/different/lateral when 'direction' or 'dimension' follows; quiet on the same words in other frames.
notes: Probes: 'opposite direction' 0.60, 'either direction' 0.53, 'other direction' 0.44, 'lateral dimension' 1.00, 'different directions' 0.68; 'The opposite of hot' 0.04, 'On the other hand' 0.002, 'asked for directions' 0.03. The + pole peaks on ' direction' itself and the logit lens suppresses 'direction', so this pole anticipates the noun.
